values.goal: Establish the production crate, root parser, dispatch, schemas, completion, generated help, and release artifact.
values.required_outcome: parser purity help schema completion and artifact provenance is produced at an exact revision and independently reproducible.
declared_scope: `main`, library `run`, Clap root/subcommands, global flags, output mode selection, typed top-level errors, version provenance, schema export, completion generation, and documentation generation.
authority_boundary: Issue V3-03 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked changes on main
Bind only after typed doctor reports ready
Do not cross dependency or stop gates
Keep evidence producer-derived and exact-revision bound
